        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.FateCollection'),0)=1
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.Kind'),-1)=2)),
    CHECK(COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory'),0)=0 OR

        AND json_type(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory')='true'
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.FateCollection'),0)=0
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.Kind'),-1)=2
        AND json_type(template_json,'$.StackLimit')='integer'
        AND json_extract(template_json,'$.StackLimit') BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295
        AND location IN (45,255) AND typeof(count)='integer' AND count BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647
        AND count<=COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.StackLimit'),0))),
    CHECK(location<>45 OR (typeof(slot)='integer' AND slot BETWEEN 0 AND 49
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory'),0)=1)),

local_fate_exchange_purchases.SQL:
CREATE TABLE local_fate_exchange_purchases (
    account TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_entry_accounts(account),
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(event_id)='integer' AND event_id=4171),
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(product_id)='integer'),
    period INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(period)='integer' AND
        ((product_id IN (490023504,490023509,490023514,490023515) AND period=0)
            OR (product_id=490023506 AND period=1) OR (product_id IN (490023507,490023510) AND period=2))),
    period_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(period_key)='text' AND
        ((period=0 AND period_key='') OR (period IN (1,2) AND length(period_key)=8
            AND period_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND period_key BETWEEN '00010101' AND '99991231'
            AND COALESCE(strftime('%Y%m%d',substr(period_key,1,4)||'-'||substr(period_key,5,2)||'-'||substr(period_key,7,2),'+0 days')=period_key,0)))),
    purchased INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(purchased)='integer' AND purchased=1),
    buyer_character_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(buyer_character_id)='integer' AND buyer_character_id BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),
    account_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(account_revision)='integer' AND account_revision>0),
    character_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(character_revision)='integer' AND character_revision>0),
    receipt_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt_key)='text' AND length(receipt_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND receipt_key='fate-exchange:4171:'||product_id||':'||period||':'||period_key),
    receipt_input_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(receipt_input_json)='text' AND length(receipt_input_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
        AND json_valid(receipt_input_json) AND json_type(receipt_input_json)='object'
        AND COALESCE(json_type(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Product')='object' AND json_type(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Material')='object'
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Product.TemplateId')=product_id
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Product.Kind')=2
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Product.FirstBagSlot')=65 AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Product.LastBagSlot')=120
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Material.TemplateId')=490023498
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Material.Kind')=2 AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Material.AccountCommonInventory')=1
            AND json_type(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Period')='integer' AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Period')=period
            AND json_type(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Cost')='integer' AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.Cost')=
                CASE product_id WHEN 490023504 THEN 300 WHEN 490023506 THEN 15 WHEN 490023507 THEN 60
                    WHEN 490023509 THEN 200 WHEN 490023510 THEN 20 WHEN 490023514 THEN 200 WHEN 490023515 THEN 30 END
            AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.Offer.SourceExpiration')='2030-11-11 06:00:00'
            AND json_type(receipt_input_json,'$.PeriodKey')='text' AND json_extract(receipt_input_json,'$.PeriodKey')=period_key

    CHECK(location<>44 OR (slot BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND count=1
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.FateCollection'),0)=1
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.Kind'),-1)=2)),
    CHECK(COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory'),0)=0 OR
        (COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory'),0)=1
        AND json_type(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory')='true'
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.FateCollection'),0)=0
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.Kind'),-1)=2
        AND json_type(template_json,'$.StackLimit')='integer'
        AND json_extract(template_json,'$.StackLimit') BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295
        AND location IN (45,255) AND typeof(count)='integer' AND count BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647
        AND count<=COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.StackLimit'),0))),
    CHECK(location<>45 OR (typeof(slot)='integer' AND slot BETWEEN 0 AND 49
        AND COALESCE(json_extract(template_json,'$.AccountCommonInventory'),0)=1)),
